resources.string: This service reads nothing on your screen and does nothing by itself. Android only lets an app with an accessibility service on use the microphone during a call, so One Recorder needs it to record your calls. Recordings stay on this phone.
Lets One Dialer record your calls. Start and stop recordings from the call screen in One Dialer, and find them in One Dialer › Settings › Call recording.
Turn on One Recorder under Installed apps
If Android says the setting is restricted: open App info, tap ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, then come back and turn the service on.
Shows while a call is being recorded
Stops the phone from switching the recorder off while it\'s idle
Recording laws differ by country. You are responsible for telling the other person and getting their consent where it\'s required.
Strong: lifts the other person more
Please read this before you record a call.
Nothing is recorded on its own. You start and stop every recording yourself, from One Dialer\'s call screen.
Follow the law where you live
Call recording laws differ by country and region. Some places allow it when one person on the call agrees, others need everyone on the call to agree, and some don\'t allow it at all.
The other person isn\'t told that you\'re recording. You\'re responsible for telling them, getting their consent where the law requires it, and using recordings lawfully.
They\'re never uploaded. They leave this phone only if you share them.
Records you and the other person at full volume, on the earpiece, speaker, Bluetooth or headphones. Set up once with Wireless debugging; no computer or root needed.
Settings › About phone: tap Build number 7 times
Turn on Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code, then type the code into One Recorder\'s notification
Not running. Needs Wi-Fi and Wireless debugging to start
Turns on the first time the helper starts
In Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code. Keep that open and type the 6-digit code here.
Paired. Calls are now recorded on both sides.
Paired, but the helper didn\'t start. Tap Start in One Recorder.
That didn\'t work. Keep the pairing dialog open and send the code again.
